text:
alex: Heads up — I pushed a prototype for probabilistic notify/backoff into branch console/slo-prob-backoff. Want quick feedback on API shape + routing UX before we flag for a limited rollout.

samira: link? also curious how this differs from sampling vs suppression.

alex: https://git.internal/redwood/console/+/console/slo-prob-backoff 

ben: Quick Q: if we use probability, are we still guaranteed at least one page for critical SLOs? worried about silent failures for high-severity alerts.

jamie: idea: keep a required_override boolean for severity >= P1, but allow probability for P2/P3. Also add a quiet_window_s. Example payload: 
```json
{
  "rule":"latency_p95",
  "threshold_ms":200,
  "notify":{ "channels":["#ops"], "probability":0.1, "quiet_window_s":300 }
}
```

nate: I like that. must also be explicit in console UX: show "expected notify rate" and an estimated number/day based on historical signals. otherwise product teams will freak out.

samira: Can we expose a dry-run preview per-tenant? e.g., simulate 7 days and show which incidents would have fired and which would be suppressed. That would help adoption.

alex: Yep — added a dry-run API + preview UI in the branch. Dry-run example: 
```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/notify/dryrun" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"acme","rule_id":"latency_p95","window_days":7}'
```

jamie: telemetry note: we need metrics for suppressed_by_probability, suppression_rate_by_tenant, and suppressed_but_exceeded_severity to audit regressions. Prefer counters + labels {tenant,rule,severity}.

alex: Agree — will add counters and a firehose snapshot for the preview flow. Also adding an eval-runner to replay historical signals so teams can verify SLI impact.

nate: rollout plan suggestion: feature-flagged per-org, enable preview only by default, GA after 2 weeks of no critical misses and telem shows <0.5% critical suppressed.

ben: ok. also add a hard fail-safe: if error_budget_burn > X% in 1h, temporarily disable probability and escalate to primary channel.

samira: UX nit: in the console rule editor, show an inline tooltip: "Probability reduces notify volume but does not change SLO computation". Important to avoid confusion. :bulb: 

alex: Action items: alex -> add API docs + telemetry names; jamie -> update console mock to show expected notify rate; samira -> wording for tooltip; nate -> add rollout gating criteria; ben -> review fail-safe threshold. Planning to open a WIP PR for review tomorrow. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: console/slo-prob-backoff -> staging (sha: c3f4a2d).

alex: Thanks all — will post a short RFC once I incorporate these notes.
